district_name: Quarry Valley Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(B) inventory: Quarry Valley Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (member towns: Poultney, Proctor, West Rutland). Operates PK-12.
Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (official site).

board.org_name: Quarry Valley Unified Union School Board

sources.note: Quarry Valley UUSD Articles of Agreement (official; linked from GRCSU's Articles of Agreement page, grcsu.org/articles-of-agreement/): Article 9 -- board representation is proportional to population, initial membership Poultney 4 (pop. 3,432, 46%), Proctor 3 (1,741, 23%), West Rutland 3 (2,326, 31%), ten seats total, and each Proctor member carries a 0.67 weighted vote (2 votes total for Proctor); Article 10 -- three-year terms beginning and expiring on the district annual-meeting date (Town Meeting Day); Article 11 -- directors are nominated in, and elected on the Australian ballot of, the member town they represent. No fetched official document shows a post-2020-census recalculation of the 4/3/3 split, and 2026 practice matches it (two Poultney vacancies; Proctor's third seat vacant). This CORRECTS the original build's 3/3/3 model (nine seats). Minted 2026-10-27 from the clerk/SU replies of 2026-10-26: five members on direct evidence (Miser, L. Davenport, P. Davenport elected with published ends; Ohl and Dingman appointed to March 2027) and four elected with term ends held (Moser, Grabowski, Callahan, Lohnes-Watulak -- their towns and incumbency are established by the 2026 minutes and the GRCSU roster, but no fetched official source publishes their current term ends; West Rutland annual-report officer cycles recorded in research suggest 2029/2027/2028/2028 respectively, recorded here as UNVERIFIED and not minted). Proctor's third seat is vacant (term expiring 2027).

GRCSU board-information page for Quarry Valley UUSD (official; the page Superintendent Christopher Sell pointed to in his 2026-10-26 reply to CivicMirror's records request; updated 2026-10-13): current roster -- Michael Moser (Chair), Jessica Grabowski (Vice Chair), Sarah Lohnes-Watulak (Clerk), Tom Callahan, Lauren Davenport, Patricia Davenport, Lisa Miser, Meghan Ohl, Matthew Dingman -- nine seated of ten; the page publishes no towns or term ends. It spells the Poultney appointee 'Meghan Ohl' where the September 10, 2026 appointment minutes spell 'Megan Ohl' (the minutes govern the name form used here).

QVUUSD Board minutes, September 10, 2026 (OFFICIAL; district Board Documents folder): the attendance list tags each member's town (Moser/WR, Callahan/WR, Grabowski/WR, Miser/PR, Lohnes-Watulak/PR, P. Davenport/PO), and after executive session the board voted unanimously: 'MOTION to appoint Megan Ohl and Matthew Dingman for the two open Poultney seats until March 2027' -- the seats left by Eric Hier's July 2026 resignation (term to 2027) and by the unfilled successor to Linda Smith (term expired March 2026), as defined in the August 13, 2026 minutes. Both appointees must stand for election in March 2027.

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional seats, town-only electorates under Articles of Agreement Article 11): Poultney 4, Proctor 3, West Rutland 3. Nine of ten seats are filled; Proctor's third seat is vacant.
